null_controls.principle: every fix has a control that is the PLAUSIBLE wrong answer, and HAZARDS §0b: a guard that only sees deviation in the direction you expected is the same failure as one that cannot fail. Every guard below has two eyes and refuses to grade (exit 2) if either control fails to exhibit its own failure.

not_done: map-probe.mjs HAS STILL NOT RUN END TO END. This is r1's named gap and it is now mine too. It is written, S8/S12/S13 are landed, and it is queued behind a contention gate — but four attempts died on `Target page, context or browser has been closed` with the box at 4.25-4.50 per core and 4 other agents' browsers resident. Recorded as not-run, not worked around.

The `hiddenhalf` proof arm has not run either, for the same reason and in the same queue. Until it does, the claim 'the new assertion can fail' is a design argument and not a measurement, and it should be read that way.

THE LIVE PHONE LEG STILL HAS NOT COMPLETED — but the CAUSE is now found and fixed, which is more than the previous two rounds had. `tools/map/player-route.mjs`'s phone leg was missing `setRenderRate(12)`, the one line the DESKTOP leg has had all along. Without it the browser renders every rAF at full rate on swiftshader: `core/loop.js`'s own comment warns this 'starves the compositor and page.screenshot() times out', every screenshot came back FAILED, and `settle()` burned its 30 s timeout waiting for two rAF ticks that were never coming. It is an INSTRUMENT defect that had been hiding behind contention for two rounds — it also failed on a box measured at 0.65 per core, which is what rules contention out as the cause. The line is landed. The run itself is still owed.

The furthest the live leg got, before it was killed to free cores: booted at 844x390 hasTouch/isMobile, 11 controls on the glass with no `menu` among them (reproducing the r1 critic's observation), then the drawer tap landed and the glass came back with all five petals — two_hand, swap_left, swap_right, spell_cycle, menu. That is links 1 and 2 of the four-link route observed live for the first time. Links 3 and 4 are still composition.
RI-WLD06 M29 (the fresh-agent navigation test that would overturn AMENDMENT-W1-MAP-02) was not run. Unchanged from r1; it needs a fresh agent, not a browser.
